measurement_contract.corpus: 72 declared Java call paths to openat; not all application behavior
measurement_contract.workload_time: paced at 1250 operations/s; not an unpaced application slowdown estimate
measurement_contract.cpu: benchmark child process only: workload JVM for baseline, collector JVM for Tier E; excludes Tier E workload child CPU
measurement_contract.rss: benchmark child process high-water RSS; not the shared retained-state budget or combined process-tree RSS
measurement_contract.native_memory: phases.native_retained_bytes and peak_retained_bytes are native accounting, not collector heap
measurement_contract.discovery_time: post-retention collector/report observation since gate; terminal fallback is an upper bound, not syscall entry time
measurement_contract.closure: runner completion does not imply a passing coverage or whole-session verdict

cpu_ns.method: paired unique/full percent change; deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap with at least five complete pairs

peak_rss_bytes.method: paired unique/full percent change; deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap with at least five complete pairs

elapsed_ns.method: paired unique/full percent change; deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap with at least five complete pairs
